best_for: Developers who use more than one JetBrains IDE, or Android Studio, and want installs, updates and rollbacks handled from one small app.

points.title: One place for every JetBrains IDE
points.text: Toolbox installs, updates and removes JetBrains IDEs and Android Studio. Updates arrive as patches in the background, so you download less and wait less.

points.title: Roll back a bad update
points.text: You can downgrade an IDE or keep several versions side by side, including Early Access builds. Handy when an update breaks a plugin you rely on.

points.title: Projects open in the right IDE
points.text: Recent projects show in one list, with favorites at the top. One click opens each in the IDE it belongs to.

points.title: Free, account optional
points.text: The app itself is free and needs no license. Signing in to a JetBrains Account lets it activate your IDE licenses for you as it installs them.

points.title: Older Macs stop at 3.4.3
points.text: Toolbox 3.5 and later need macOS 14 or newer. On macOS 10.14 to 13 the last version that works is 3.4.3. Windows needs Windows 10 version 1809 or later.

points.title: Linux is a tarball
points.text: On Linux you extract a .tar.gz and run it from your home folder; FUSE is only needed for 2.6.2 and older. Linux is not listed on this page.

points.title: Per-user on Windows
points.text: The Windows installer installs for the current user, for x64 and Arm64. Windows goes back to 1.12 and macOS to 1.0, with the releases winget and Homebrew lack taken from JetBrains' own release feed.
